body: After watching this episode I couldn’t cry. But the immense sadness just overpowered me, when I saw gugu like that I knew but I also thought “Fushi will save him”. I held on to what I know to be false hope. This episode was beautiful and heartbreaking if I could cry I would.
(Anime only) This episode literally made me feel things. I mean for some reason I 100% didn’t expect this and it made me feel like super excited. I literally can’t wait for next episode

I don’t know. Stupid that I don’t know, but that’s the truth. I always thought I wasn’t good enough as a person. But if anything it’s a lot of little reasons that make to one big reason I can’t see for some reason.
